start_here: Say to your AI: "Search everything I keep for merlinfalcon: every list, record and file, by what was said, seen, named or written, best match first, and tell me where each hit is." It runs tool:search-everything-with-one-question at @tools and answers from each hit's said and address.
no_lists_because: It names no list: it asks every kind of record and the file names the same question from the records and files you hand in and answers one merged ranking. The caller reads them from your own store and hands them in as `records` and `files`; the run reads no store.
instructions: 0. Hand in the records and files the search covers: read them from your own store and give them as records (each {id, type, value}) and files (each file name to its text or {base64}). The run reads no store.

1. Say what you want to find: question (at most 500 characters), and optionally type to keep only one kind of record, limit 1 to 200, places (said, seen, name, written), sources (trillion, files) or index_ids.

2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:search-everything-with-one-question and that input. A picture index is asked with a vector from tool:words-as-picture-vector: hand one in as query_vectors ({model_id, model_version, vector_base64: base64 of {vector}}), or the run asks that tool itself.

3. Read result {question, terms, results, unavailable, pending}: answer from each result's said and cite it by its address: {id, type} opens the record in the person's own store, {path} the file handed in under that name.
4. unavailable names a place that could not answer and why, pending one still working: ask again in a few seconds.

worked_examples.title: One word found in three kinds of record and one file name
worked_examples.ask: Search everything I keep for merlinfalcon.
worked_examples.given: From tools/search-everything-with-one-question/test/search-everything.test.mjs (the sample the container version of this search runs; both call searchEverything): input.json is {"question": "merlinfalcon", "records": [...], "files": {...}} with the records the caller read from the person's own store, a sample-contacts row c1 ("met the merlinfalcon keeper"), a sample-invoices row i1 ("merlinfalcon feed, 3 bags"), a sample-places row p1 ("merlinfalcon aviary") and another place p2 that does not hold the word, and the files /Notes/merlinfalcon care.txt and /Notes/other.txt. The command is `node trillion-workshop/tools/workflows/do-work/run-a-function.mjs trillion-workshop/tools/search-everything-with-one-question/do-work/search-everything.mjs searchEverything < input.json`.
worked_examples.hands_back: The last line is {result: {question: "merlinfalcon", terms: ["merlinfalcon"], results: [...], unavailable: [], pending: [], sat_out: []}}. results are first the three records record:p1, record:c1 and record:i1 (each found_in ["written"], each first in its own lane with score 0.01639, each with address {id, type}) and then file:/Notes/merlinfalcon care.txt (found_in ["name"], score 0.01311, address {path}). The other place and other.txt are not listed. If the files are not handed in they appear under unavailable and the records still answer.
